normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A ESCAPES invites you to “59 Bramble Ln,” a charming retreat in Seagrove Beach’s exclusive gated community. Enjoy a chef-style kitchen, an enclosed porch for peaceful mornings, and a sparkling community pool just steps away. With a 6-seater LSV and 4 bikes included, adventure is at your fingertips—pristine beaches, local shops, and dining are just minutes away. This isn’t just a vacation home—it’s where unforgettable coastal memories are made. Start your dream escape now! Learn more below... *** HIGHLIGHTS *** Prime Location in a Gated Community, Steps from the Pool: Enjoy the exclusivity and convenience of a secure, private neighborhood with the pool just a few steps away—perfect for leisurely dips or quick refreshers.Includes 6-Person LSV and 3 Bikes for Easy Exploring: Cruise the area in style with a low-speed vehicle or hop on a bike for a breezy, carefree adventure through scenic surroundings.Open-Concept Chef's Kitchen with Stainless Steel Appliances: Cook and entertain effortlessly in a sleek, modern kitchen designed for creating memorable meals and gathering with loved ones.Screened-In Porch for Relaxing Mornings or Evenings: Unwind in comfort, soaking in the peaceful atmosphere of the outdoors without worrying about bugs—ideal for coffee at sunrise or a glass of wine at sunset.Bright, Modern Interiors with Comfortable Furnishings: Immerse yourself in a light-filled, contemporary space that feels both stylish and welcoming, offering the ultimate in relaxation.Just 0.4 Miles from Scenic 395 Beach Access: A short, easy stroll takes you to stunning coastal views and sandy shores, creating the perfect backdrop for beach days and sunset walks. Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests: "Lovely house, plenty of room, and great bathrooms. The location is fantastic, close to the square, the beach, and Publix!" – Verified Traveler"The house is beautifully decorated and very comfortable. The bikes and the LSV were such a great addition—we used them every day!" – Amir R."Perfect location. Spacious living areas with great amenities. Close to Seaside and easy beach access with the golf cart." – Jackie K. *** LIVING AREA *** The open-concept design of the main living area creates the perfect space for unforgettable moments. Unwind on luxurious, plush seating in the bright, sunlit living room, or gather for cozy movie nights on the large flat-screen TV. The seamless flow between the living, dining, and kitchen areas ensures effortless hosting, whether it’s casual family mornings or lively evenings with friends. Spacious Open-Concept Living and Dining AreaLarge Flat-Screen TV for Movie Nights and EntertainmentSophisticated Interior Décor with Comfortable, Ample Seating *** KITCHEN AND DINING *** Elevate your culinary experience and create unforgettable meals in style! This chef’s kitchen is designed for both functionality and luxury, featuring top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances and a premium Viking range to take your cooking to the next level. The spacious island, complete with an additional sink and bar seating, seamlessly blends with the modern dining area, making it perfect for everything—whether it’s a quick morning coffee or a lavish dinner party. High-End Chef’s Kitchen with Viking RangeExpansive Kitchen Island with Secondary SinkElegant Dining Table with Comfortable Seating for 6 *** COMMUNITY AMENITIES *** Step outside and immerse yourself in the charm of the Seagrove Beach community. This gated neighborhood offers a peaceful, serene atmosphere, perfect for unwinding and enjoying coastal life. Just steps from the house, the well-maintained community pool invites you to take a refreshing swim or lounge in tranquility. With a 6-person low-speed vehicle (LSV) and 4 bikes included, exploring the stunning surroundings has never been easier or more enjoyable. Serene, Gated Neighborhood for Ultimate RelaxationSparkling Community Pool Just Steps Away6-Person LSV and 4 Bikes Included for Easy Exploration *** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS *** 1st Floor: Primary Suite: King-size bed with a walk-in closet, a flat-screen TV, and an en-suite bathroom with a double vanity and stand-alone shower.King Guest Bedroom: King-size bed with a flat-screen TV and an en-suite bathroom with a stand-alone shower.Full Guest Bedroom: Two full beds with a flat-screen TV and an en-suite bathroom featuring a stand-alone shower. 2nd Floor: Family Room: Features a comfortable Twin Bed with a flat-screen TV, providing the perfect extra sleeping space for added convenience and relaxation. *** LOCATION & COMMUNITY *** Tucked away in the serene and upscale Hammocks of Seagrove Beach, this home offers the perfect escape for those craving tranquility without sacrificing convenience. Just moments from pristine beaches, charming boutique shops, and delicious local restaurants, you’ll find yourself at the heart of everything 30A has to offer while enjoying your own peaceful retreat. Beach Access (0.5 miles) – Feel the soft sand between your toes and soak up the sun at this serene, picturesque beach just minutes away.Publix Super Market (3-minute drive) – Your go-to for quick grocery runs, offering everything you need to stock up for your stay.Seaside Square (1.0 mile/5-min LSV ride) – A charming hub of activity with boutique shops, local eats, and a lively, coastal vibe perfect for an afternoon stroll.Café Thirty-A (5-min LSV ride) – Enjoy upscale dining with a laid-back beach vibe, serving delicious food in a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere. *** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW *** Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes and the LSV. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSVs (Low Speed Vehicles) are NOT permitted in Seaside, Rosemary Beach, or Alys Beach.IMPORTANT NOTICE: CONSTRUCTION IN THE AREA - Please note that construction is ongoing throughout the 30A area, and we are unable to guarantee the absence of construction near the property. Currently, there is active construction taking place just one house away from this home, with an unknown completion date. We appreciate your understanding and patience as the area continues to develop. *** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***
